layout: One upright sheet with 21 principal prose/display baselines, counting the lower row of the upper small drawing with its following prose and excluding subsidiary annotation lines and internal drawing rows. The dated left margin faces the first sentence; an outlined supralinear explanation joins structure torique. Four definition baselines follow. Two stage rows, an inserted droit, and a kernel annotation occupy the upper middle. A small subgroup drawing stands at left, followed by a larger lattice with two braces, diagonal notes on both sides, and a quotient drawing at right. The lower paragraph has a product, a right boundary note, two formulas with struck superscripts, and a lighter lower-left number. Reading order follows the upright prose; diagonal marginal material remains marginal.

notes:
The manuscript dated (29.11.83) introduces a compact oriented surface with toric structures on its boundary components, and writes a quotient definition for SRT in L04–L07. It calls the next rows a dévissage, then introduces R^I with a supralinear droit and a kernel annotation whose argument is read alpha. The small subgroup drawing, the large lattice, the NB expression, and the quotient drawing are transcribed as source claims and drawings, with their indices and doubtful letter forms retained. Display (*) ends in a blunt dash before 1; its preceding T is visibly overworked, and the proposed underlying letter is uncertain. The lower paragraph speaks of a marquage, writes the product point, and gives two formulas with cancelled raised signs. This reading supplies no proof or new mathematical statement. The additional small dotted glyph below d’indice is retained without inventing an attachment. The top explanation and droit have their source attachment contours drawn; the two side braces remain with the lattice, and the quotient’s right brace and lower wavy stroke are preserved. Second-reading targets are localized complete formulas, coherent prose baselines, or single marginal passages; neutral scope labels explicitly exclude crossing context. Twenty-one crop files were viewed, covering nineteen physical loci. Two original crops were incomplete at unresolved descender/strike boundaries; completion files replace those two for the reading evidence. No decided locus was recropped. The whole sheet and both supplied halves were read line by line. No OCR, external source, other page, TeX compilation, or mathematical verification was used.

Legibility and witness comparison. The exposed upright prose is generally legible, but the initial SRT argument, cancelled definition words, first star, central lattice subscript, and final raised signs retain merged or covered strokes. The rotated left-note crop recovers a coherent sequence that C largely preserves: Jusqu’ici on ne fait intervenir, à l’exclusion, dont la défini., exige une str. suppl., and cf ci-dessous. H has substantial gaps in this passage. The devissage and can_droit crops support C’s dévissage and literal can!, while the definition crop supports resp. rather than H’s expansion respectant. H’s descriptions usefully record the small drawing and quotient brace, although their endpoint and placement details require comparison with the image. In the small_diagram crop, both lower vertical returns are exposed; the left upper junction remains obscured by cancelled lettering and a crossing diagonal, so the revised drawing preserves those strokes with an explicit doubt. The sequence crop exposes a blunt terminal connector and an overworked foreground T; the latter’s underlying identity stays open. Both witnesses leave the dotted glyph below d’indice unrecorded, and it is retained as doubtful after comparison with the boundary_note crop. Agreement on the recurring proposed fraktur letter does not settle its exact alphabetic form. The two final-formula crops show cancellation at the exponent positions that H’s formulas print as live signs. These comparisons apply to this sheet alone. Blind audit leaves the recurring looped group letter at the same preferred fraktur-S reading with its local uncertainty. The long upright beside the torus U continues into the t of torique on the baseline below; it is not supplied as a new subscript. The lower lattice endpoint returns are reproduced with uncertain head status. Local alternatives are added within crossed text, at the de/des ending, at the boundary-note separator and at its detached dotted glyph. The written can! and contracted défini. are retained. No mathematical claim was checked in this audit.
